meta.title: Five Quiet Thresholds Across Northern Malabar
meta.excerpt: Five unhurried dawn encounters across sacred groves, timber shipyards, and highland spice valleys.
meta.headerQuote: Every threshold asks us to slow down before stepping inside.
meta.author: Sree Jith
meta.alt: Morning light across northern Kerala waterways and sacred groves

cover.alt: Canopy light filtering into a sacred grove in northern Kerala

slides.title: Lantern Light Outside the Kavu
slides.text: Before sunrise drums begin, oil wicks are lit along laterite thresholds where forest patches have remained untouched for generations.
slides.alt: Quiet morning threshold in a Malabar forest sanctuary

slides.title: Hand-Adzed Malabar Teak
slides.text: Master uru shipwrights stillfair ocean hulls entirely by eye and plumb-line, scenting the tidal air with seasoned timber and coir.
slides.alt: Traditional timber craftsmanship along the Malabar estuary

slides.title: Forty Yards of Morning Warp
slides.text: Entire village lanes wake together at first light to brush rice-starch sizing along stretched cotton warps before tropical heat rises.
slides.alt: Early morning craft rhythm in central Kerala

slides.title: Shade-Grown Pepper & Cardamom
slides.text: High above the coastal plains, heirloom Kalluvally pepper vines climb native silver-oak and jackfruit canopies in cool monsoon mist.

slides.title: Cardamom Tea on the Verandah
slides.text: The richest moments happen after notebooks close—sharing black tea and stories on a cool oxide verandah as evening settles over the river.
slides.alt: Unhurried dusk reflection along the Bharathapuzha river
